svg.title: Smell over the whole floor
svg.desc: The settled mean receptor reading over the floor at three food densities, from odour.rs: white is saturated (0.9 or more), where an orb's own gradient has almost no range left.
svg.text: Smell over the whole floor: where the receptors saturate
Settled field (10 min in), mean reading over the 8 receptor types at nose height, one sample per 4 m; palest: 0.9 or more
Open issue: with every orb summed, the field saturates at high density and the gradient to any one orb nearly vanishes.
